d:
Hi there all. I know a version of this was already uploaded not too long ago, but when that went up I was just a few pages short of finishing my own translation. That's just how it goes sometimes. I was honestly shocked another person was so enthusiastic to translate it so soon so kudos to Scart haha. I didn't want all that effort I put in to go to waste, though, so I'm still going ahead and uploading it. Not to say Scart's version isn't perfectly fine as well, though. You can read whichever version you fancy :)

If you can, please support Kouji by buying the official work! https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01524652.html
n: [Doujinshi] [Hawk Bit (Kouji)] The TS Succubus Banished from the Party Fails at Revenge [Morbin]
